name: Key cutting and duplication
summary: How expats duplicate house, mailbox, and cabinet keys in Singapore — mall kiosks vs locksmiths, restricted keyways, and condo access-card realities beyond metal keys.
body:
Key-cutting kiosks handle common pin-tumbler copies quickly; restricted or dimple keys need authorised channels. Condos increasingly mix metal keys with access cards/fobs that mall cutters cannot clone casually.

## Common jobs
- Backup flat/room keys for helpers and trailing partners
- Mailbox and padlock copies
- Car keys (often dealer/specialist only)
- Broken-key extraction referrals
- Advice when landlord forbids unapproved copies

Always confirm tenancy rules before cutting extras.

## How to choose
Bring a clean original; worn blanks copy badly. Ask about keyway brand and whether the blank matches. For high-security keys, use the issuing locksmith. Access cards usually go through MCST/managing agent — not the mall booth.

## Practical tip
Label keys the same day you cut them. Photograph fob serial numbers before they vanish into a Grab seat.
